basis: Motor neuron degeneration and dementia define the disease; ophthalmoplegia reflects neurologic dysfunction rather than intrinsic eye damage.
Lymphatic vascular malformation causes lower-limb lymphedema in 2/2 patients; edema alone does not establish separate skin damage.
Defining hair/nail abnormalities, dental enamel defects and taurodontism, and increased bone density involve all three axes.
Cardiac myxomas, contractures and endocrinopathy define the syndrome; cutaneous myxomas are major Carney manifestations, supporting skin involvement.
Mature teratoma originates in the ovary; reproductive neoplasms without endocrine dysfunction have no axis.
Congenital atrioventricular septal malformation associated with tetralogy of Fallot.
Myoepithelial tumor originates in extremity soft tissues, including subfascial connective tissue and subcutis.
Disease of hair, nails and skin with hypotrichosis, leukonychia and progressive palmoplantar keratoderma.
Small-fiber nerve injury defines disease; keratoconjunctivitis sicca affects the ocular surface in 30-79%. Xerostomia and sweating changes alone do not establish other organ damage.
Disease directly involving the vagus nerve; downstream organ damage is not established across this umbrella.
Fungal infection directly involves the toenail.
Benign female reproductive system neoplasm according to its ancestry; no covered organ is established.
Primary loss of ovarian endocrine function; downstream osteoporosis is a separately diagnosed disease.
Skeletal dysplasia with abnormal growth, advanced bone age and early osteoarthritis; developmental stagnation alone does not establish neurologic injury.
Developmental delay (2/3), callosal hypoplasia (1/3) and congenital diaphragmatic muscle defects (3/5) characterize the syndrome; cardiac and renal anomalies each ~20%.
Acquired dystonic movement disorder; abnormal muscle contractions do not independently establish skeletal muscle disease.
Osteochondrodysplasia directly damages cartilage and bone; proposed nutritional or toxic causes do not establish an endocrine or infectious disorder.
Carcinoma originates in the penis, a reproductive organ outside the axes; no urinary tract origin is specified.
Alport nephropathy and esophageal leiomyomatosis define disease; sensorineural hearing loss 30-79%, cataract 3/4. Airway leiomyomatosis is <30%.
Congenital vascular tumor typically occupies skin and subcutis; heart failure and thrombocytopenia occur in fewer than 30%.
Hepatic porphyrin metabolism disorder defined by cutaneous manifestations; no evidence establishes additional commonly damaged organs.
Inherited rod-cone retinal degeneration causes night blindness and visual-field loss.
Immunodeficiency with defining autoimmune cytopenias; autoimmune melanocyte loss causing vitiligo reported in 1/1. Recurrent infections alone do not establish chronic lung damage.
Defined congenital skin disorder with persistent palmar erythema; superficial telangiectasia does not establish a separate damaging vascular disorder.
Skeletal malformations, microcephaly/intellectual disability and oral clefting define the syndrome; horseshoe kidney and urethral malformation occur in 30-79%.
